name: Lloyd Irving Dating Sim
source:
A short vanity project based on a Tales of Symphonia OC fanfiction.

In the style of the Persona games' 'social links', you play through ten events that take place across the ToS storyline, and try to win Lloyd's affections.

There are a total of 12 endings, ranging from friendship, to romance, to friendzoned, and the outcome is all up to you!

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=25391]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
一部以《仙乐传说》原创角色同人小说为基础的短篇自娱作品。游戏采用《女神异闻录》“社群链接”的形式，玩家将在《仙乐传说》剧情期间经历十个事件，并努力赢得罗伊德的好感。共有12种结局，从友情、恋爱到被当作朋友，结果完全由你决定！

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=25391]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
